36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
123574: Sakamoto is the protagonist of the series who is a model student for all in his school. He is the perfect man who can solve any problem with a kind yet calm persona. Because of this, many girls fall for him, and his male classmates resent him.
127462: Kubota is a rather stocky young man with a heavy build and frizzy, wavy hair that parts in the middle. He seems on the shorter side compared to his peers and had a round nose with small, brown eyes and freckles on his cheeks.
135859: A long-time delinquent who is in his 30's, has an IQ of 180 and had a strange past. He is popular among delinquents due to his tendency of targeting popular students while manipulating others to do his dirty work.
135861: Morita is one of Sakamoto's classmates.
135862: Mario is a member of the three-member delinquent group together with Atsushi and Kenken.
135863: Male gym teacher. In the name of student guidance, he is on the lookout every day for students who break the school rules.
135864: Hayabusa is the leader of the second-year delinquent group. He seems to be more level-headed than the majority of the other delinquents, though he can still be easily angered when provoked. Due to his typically cool demeanor, a handful of underclassmen look up to him.
135865: Kuronuma Aina is a female student in Sakamoto's class who falls for him. She is very popular among boys but has no interest for anyone else except Sakamoto, which makes her disliked by other girls.
135866: Kubota Shigemi is Yoshinobu's mother, who fell for Sakamoto ever since she met him, as he resembles Chon Choriso, her favorite Korean actor.
135867: Yasuda is one of Sakamoto's classmates.
135869: Tanaka is a female student who belongs to Aina's circle of friends.
135871: Sera Yuuya is a male student who is in the same class as Sakamoto. He disliked him for always stealing the class' attention. Sera was a teenage model until an incident involving Sakamoto and a wasp, and now is a class clown who makes bee jokes.
135872: A weak-willed class representative. Photography is her hobby, and she always takes pictures of how her class is doing. She has a strong feelings about Sakamoto.
135873: A girl that is sensitive to new trends. She seems to speak foreign accents very well, and she is found usually hanging around with Fujita Megumi's group.
135874: Mii-chan is a female student who belongs to Megumi's circle of friends.
135875: Kenken is a member of the three-member delinquent group together with Atsushi and Mario.
135876: Yagi is a female student who belongs to Aina's circle of friends.
135878: One of the two college students who invited Sakamoto to the mixer.
135879: One of the two college students who invited Sakamoto to the mixer.
135880: Kana-chan is a female student who belongs to Megumi's circle of friends.
135881: A classmate in class 1-2, and one of the delinquent trio. His trademark is a red hat. Along with Kenken and Mario, he targets Sakamoto for bullying, but gets rebutted each and every time.
135882: The homeroom teacher for class 1-2. Guides his students using his life experiences where he has overcome many dangerous situations.
135884: A member of the second-year delinquent group. Second after 8823. Makes first-years run errands for him and take care of him in general.
135885: A Korean idol of whom Shigemi is a fan. Sakamoto's appearance is close to Chon, which partially explains why she falls for the former.
